quotes.text: Use the Terminal Configurations object to apply configurations to your readers.

old_evidence.text: You can override account-level settings with location-level settings.
Any configuration changes made with the API or Dashboard can take up to 10 minutes to reflect on the target readers.
After you delete the configuration, the readers in the location default back to the account’s default configuration within 10 minutes.
You can’t apply the default configuration directly to a Location.

findings: November identifies the Terminal Configurations object and links a Dashboard/API article variant each. This capture is an index, with no configuration hierarchy, setup, preview, propagation or deletion behavior.

May documents account-default and location-level setting inheritance, with settings not overridden at a location coming from the Stripe-provisioned account default. The account default cannot be applied directly to a Location. May states zone configuration private preview and changes can take up to 10 minutes.

May Dashboard supports changing the account default and creating, changing and deleting local configuration. Deleting the local Dashboard configuration returns readers to account defaults within 10 minutes. API example lists account default, creates and assigns a Configuration to a location via configuration_overrides, independently shows update and delete.

The mapped summary captures hierarchy and API examples but compresses default-vs-local Dashboard operations and cross-applies Dashboard deletion consequences to an API bullet. The reciprocal Terminal hardware/fleet concept already routes to it.
historical_claims_to_preserve: Retain the May 1, 2026 factual snapshot for account defaults, location overrides and setting-level fallthrough, zone private preview, documented propagation, separate Dashboard and API flows and direct-assignment restriction.
conflicts: The summary's Dashboard line could be read as permitting create/delete of the automatically provisioned account default. May documents updating the default and separately creating/editing/deleting local configuration. The associated fallback/time statement is in the Dashboard local-delete section; the API delete section only shows deletion and supplies no separate timing claim. The separate November API Delete reference documents deletion, not reader fallback timing.

May's prose points to a configuration Retrieve endpoint for account-default lookup while its example calls List with is_account_default=true. The separate November List reference documents the filter (raw/stripe-api-terminal-configuration-list-2026-11-07.md:41-42); the Retrieve reference is for a single configuration. Keep the list route and identify the prose/example mismatch.

The mapped source and hardware/fleet concept present the May zone-level private preview and propagation text without a capture date. The November index does not refresh those claims. Preserve May provenance and use the general up-to timing language.

The related concept's API paragraph at wiki/concepts/stripe-terminal-hardware-orders.md:89 also says deleting a location configuration reverts readers to the account default. Move or scope the fallback to May's Dashboard local-delete workflow (old raw lines 81-94); May API Delete and the separate November API Delete reference document the deletion action without a reviewed reader-fallback consequence.
unresolved_questions: The November Dashboard/API variant bodies are outside the capture, so no updated availability, preview status, workflow compatibility or timing can be inferred. The mapped file's API fallback/timing assertions are stronger than its assigned API evidence.

answers.Q1: For https://docs.stripe.com/terminal/fleet/configurations-overview, the November 7, 2026 capture states that the Terminal Configurations object applies reader settings and routes implementers to Dashboard or API variants. It carries no documented setup prerequisites or state transitions itself (new raw lines 5-14). The May 1, 2026 capture documents the account/location hierarchy for splash screen, tipping and offline mode. Stripe provisions account defaults; a fleet operator can override per location; the readers inherit settings without an override and cannot receive the account default through direct location assignment. API/Dashboard changes can take up to 10 minutes and zone configuration was private preview (old raw lines 8-26 and old raw lines 100-112). The Dashboard operator can update account settings, create or change a location configuration, or delete local configuration, with the last action reverting readers to account defaults within 10 minutes (old raw lines 32-61 and old raw lines 63-94). An API integration lists account defaults using the filter, creates a Configuration and associates it via locations.update's configuration_overrides, or updates/deletes a Configuration (old raw lines 100-130 and old raw lines 137-174). source-stripe-terminal-configurations retains the May model and examples but needs clearer Dashboard-vs-API and default-vs-local deletion wording.

Keep the dated May account/default/override inheritance boundaries, up-to propagation, and zone preview (new raw lines 5-14, old raw lines 8-26 and old raw line 102). Repair the mapped summary's Dashboard wording to distinguish update of the default and create/update/delete of local configuration. Attribute the account-default fallback and 10-minute wording to Dashboard local deletion as documented, preserving the independent API deletion operation (old raw lines 34-61 and old raw lines 81-94 and old raw lines 164-174). The prior account-default lookup prose links to Retrieve, but the example uses List with is_account_default=true (old raw lines 100-112); preserve the documented List filter and route single-object lookup separately. Apply the same deletion clarification to the API paragraph at wiki/concepts/stripe-terminal-hardware-orders.md:89. Tie default fallback to the dated Dashboard local-deletion steps (old raw lines 81-94). The independent API passages describe deletion without specifying a reader fallback (old raw lines 164-174 and raw/stripe-api-terminal-configuration-delete-2026-11-07.md:5-7 and :24-41).
